scope: All 24 coefficients for a hand-specified 2x3x4 nonbiological landscape from independent background finite differences.
preprocessing: Uniform observed Cartesian product; fitness as supplied, maximize=True, epsilon=0; no imputation, transformations, duplicates, sample weighting or measurement-error propagation; graph nodes verified unchanged. Reference is first observation. No RNG in OLS. Full order=3; integer-polynomial row scores centered by their mean, fixed in synthetic.json.

comparison.justification: Conservative float64 budget for small forward transforms and least squares; expected generated without production helpers.
